entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Natural Shapeshifter
entries.desc: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.
entries.change: Moved from Balance to Restoration. Moved from column 4 to column 3.

entries.name: Nature Focus
entries.desc: Gives you a 70% chance to cast arcane and nature spells without being interrupted by damage.
entries.change: Moved from Tier 2 to Tier 1. Values unchanged, wording adjusted.

entries.name: Nature's Grace
entries.desc: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Nature's Majesty
entries.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 4%.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Nature's Splendor
entries.desc: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: primitive bite
entries.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 damage, and generating a lot of threat.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Power of transformation
entries.desc: Instantly converts mana to 40 energy. The effect of reducing the cost of transformation spells also reduces the cost of transformation power.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Subtlety
entries.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.
entries.change: Max rank changed from 5 to 3. Moved from tier 3 to tier 2. Effect override.

entries.name: Thick Leather
entries.desc: When in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base armor per level; each defense skill point that exceeds your level five times also provides 2.00 base armor. This number is further multiplied by these forms.
entries.change: Maximum rank changed from 5 to 3. Moved from column 3 to column 4. Effect override.

entries.name: Heating Up
entries.desc: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Redoubt
entries.desc: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 20%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Flawless Execution
entries.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Quietus
entries.desc: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
entries.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Rage of the Farseer
entries.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Agonizing Flames
entries.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.
entries.change: Classic Era is called Enhanced Searing Pain. Maximum rating changed from 5 to 3. Moved from column 4 to column 2. Effect rewritten.

entries.name: Bane
entries.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.
entries.change: Moved from Tier 2 to Tier 1. Values unchanged, wording adjusted.

entries.name: Bane of Havoc
entries.desc: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Cataclysm
entries.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.
entries.change: Max level changed from 5 to 3. Moved from tier 1 to tier 2. Value adjustment: 10%(Classic Era: 3%).

entries.name: Curse of Exhaustion
entries.desc: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
entries.change: Move from Tier 5 to Tier 4. Value adjustment: 30%(Classic Era: 10%).

entries.name: Decimation
entries.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Demonic Aegis
entries.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Demonic Embrace
entries.desc: Increases your total Stamina by 15%.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Demonic Knowledge
entries.desc: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Demonic Pact
entries.desc: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Fel Vitality
entries.desc: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.
entries.change: Classic Era: Demon Intelligence. Max rank increased from 5 to 3. Effect rewritten.

entries.name: Improved Corruption
entries.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Improved Drains
entries.desc: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Improved Health Funnel
entries.desc: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.
entries.change: Moved from tier 2 to tier 1. Effect override.

entries.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
entries.desc: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Incinerate
entries.desc: Deals 99 to 115 (+71.4% of spell power) Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Pandemic
entries.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Shadow and Flame
entries.desc: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Soul Harvest
entries.desc: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.
entries.change: Moved from Tier 7 to Tier 5. Values unchanged, wording adjusted.

entries.name: Suppression
entries.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Wrack
entries.desc: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 (+14.3% of spell power) Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.

entries.name: Improved Berserker Rage
entries.desc: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.
entries.change: Moved from tier 6 to tier 5. Effect override.

entries.name: Raging Blow
entries.desc: Reduces the rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind by 3.
entries.change: Forever's new talent.

entries.name: Shield Specialization
entries.desc: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.
entries.change: Effect Overrides.
